follow-up time: From enrolment during pregnancy to delivery
exposure: Mechanical cervical ripening/induction of labour with a transcervical Foley's catheter balloon
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC)
Duration of labour after balloon expulsion
cohort: Women with a singleton pregnancy and cephalic presentation who had one previous uncomplicated caesarean section and were scheduled for mechanical cervical ripening/induction of labour at term for routine obstetric indications
finding: Mechanical induction of labour with a transcervical Foley's catheter balloon without the use of ecbolics was a safe and effective method of VBAC in women refusing ecbolics, with a 39.8% success rate.
